about: Solomon sends Zadok to bring Zion's garment, its fringe and its keepsakes to Menelik, with a message that the Ark be honoured, sworn by and prayed towards; Zadok's son Azarias hints at the true Lady, a covenant is made for his house, and the company sets out under Michael's guidance, carried above the ground across sea and land.

sentences.i: Chapter 51: Where he said to Zadok the priest: 'Go and bring that garment which is upon her'
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ ዘ- 'where / at the point where' (ዘ- 'that which' + verb); ch. 49 has the same heading form with a bare verb (ኀበ ባረኮ). ዘይቤሎ 'what he said to him' (ዘ- + ይቤ + -ሎ). ሑር is a spelling of the imperative ሖር 'go' (ሖረ), written ሖር in the next unit. ልብሰ 'garment' is accusative (ending -ä, written ሰ), object of አምጽእ 'bring!'. ዘላዕሌሃ 'which (is) upon her' (ዘ- + ላዕሌ- 'upon' + -ሃ 'her'): the garment on Zion, the Ark. The speaker is Solomon (the 'her' is Zion, feminine).

sentences.l: And-he-said-to-him to-Zadok priest: go, bring that garment which-upon-her, to-Zion, and-take for-you this garment-which-is-better than-it, and-clothe-her over the-two which-beneath-her;
sentences.i: And he said to Zadok the priest: 'Go, bring that garment that is upon Zion, and take for yourself this garment, which is better than it, and clothe her over the two that are beneath her;
sentences.n: Imperatives throughout: ሖር 'go', አምጽእ 'bring' (አምጽአ, causative of መጽአ 'come'), ንሣእ 'take' (ወንሣእ), ወአልብሳ 'and clothe her' (imperative of the causative አልበሰ + -ኣ 'her', written -ሳ). ለጽዮን: ለ- 'to/for' marks the owner, 'the garment ... of Zion'. ለከ 'for yourself'. SOURCE ODDITY: ልብሰዘይኄይስ is printed as one word; read ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ 'a garment which is better' (ኀየሰ 'be good, be better'; ይኄይስ 3ms imperfect), and እምኔሁ 'than it' (the comparative እም-): the garment is 'better than' the one on Zion. What is done with the garment brought from her is not stated. መልዕልተ ፪ 'over the two', ዘታሕቴሃ 'that are beneath her': I take it that two earlier coverings lie under the new one, so that the new garment goes on top (?); the figure ፪ is the Ethiopic digit 2 (ክልኤቱ).

The remaining words are technical weaving terms I cannot fix from the lexicon: ቄፋዝ, ዝብጦ, ወእኑም, ዘሜላት. ስህቦ 'drawing, pulling' (ሰሐበ 'draw, drag') and ፍትሎ 'twisting' (ፈተለ 'twist, spin') are clear; the contrast seems to be 'drawn (wire?) gold' as against 'twisted thread'. Only the contrast, not the terms, is rendered (?).

sentences.l: And-5 from-her-ሞጻ (?) to-Zion, አናጹት (?), and-10 likenesses-of their-selves which-they-made their-ransom, princes-of Philistines;
sentences.i: Of Zion's fringe (?), five are ... (?), and ten are likenesses of themselves, which the princes of the Philistines made as their ransom;
sentences.n: ወ፭ 'and five', ወ፲ 'and ten' (Ethiopic digits, as ፭ = ኀምስቱ, ፲ = ዐሠርቱ). እሞጻሃ: እም 'of / from' + ሞጻ + -ሃ 'her': ሞጻ I take, from the sense of the next lines, as the 'hem, fringe' of a garment (?) — bells hang on the hem of Aaron's robe in Exodus 28:33–34, but the word ሞጻ is not found there — so 'five from her (Zion's) fringe'. The same guess is kept for ሞጻ in units 13 and 25. አናጹት is unknown to me (?). The Philistine offering is 1 Samuel 6:4–5, 17–18, where the Philistine lords return the Ark with five golden tumours (?) and five golden mice; so 'five ... and ten' may mean five such and ten likenesses together with them. አምሳለ ነፍስቶሙ 'likeness of their souls/selves' (አምሳል construct); ዘገብሩ 'which they made'; ቤዛሆሙ 'as their ransom' (ቤዛ + -ሆሙ); መኳንንተ ኢሎፍሊ 'princes of the Philistines', a construct chain in apposition. The sense is held loosely (?).

sentences.i: And of the bells, a golden likeness, which came out of the ... of Kadesh (?), as Moses was commanded on Sinai to make bells on the garment of Aaron his brother.
sentences.n: ጸናጽል 'bells, rattles' (also the sistrum); the allusion is Exodus 28:33–35, golden bells on the hem of the high priest's robe, and the commandment given to Moses on Sinai. ዘወፅአ 'which went out' (ዘ- + ወፅአ, 3ms perfect). እምደረ ቃዴስ: እም 'from'; ደረ is construct; ደር I take as 'hill-country / region' (?); Kadesh is the place of Numbers 20, so the link of the golden likeness to Kadesh is the source's own and unclear (?). ዘተአዘዞ ለሙሴ 'which was commanded to Moses' (ተአዘዘ passive + -ኦ; ለ- marks the person). ከመ ይግበር 'that he make' (jussive). ጸናጽለ 'bells' (accusative). ልብሰ አሮን እኁሁ 'garment-of Aaron his brother'.

sentences.i: Gather them into the garment of Zion, and send them to him, to my son David;
sentences.n: ወአስተጋብኦን: imperative of አስተጋብአ 'gather together' (causative-reflexive stem) + -ን '(f.) them'; ወ- 'and' begins a new command, so read as 'and gather them'. The things gathered are the fringe-pieces and likenesses of the previous two units. ልብሳ ለጽዮን 'her garment, Zion's' (suffix doubled by ለ-). ወሰድ 'and send' (ሰደደ 'send, drive away'; imperative) with ሎቱ 'to him' repeated by ለወልድየ ዳዊት 'to my son David'. David is Menelik, who has taken his father's name as king; the speaker is Solomon.

I read ሀበነ 'give us' + a stray አ (as in the Queen's messages of ch. 33–36) + እም 'from' + ዘፈረ 'fringe of' (ዘፈር 'edge, fringe', the published guess from the sense (?)). The parallel in the next unit, ሀበነ ዘናመልክ እምዘፈረ ልብሳ, confirms 'from the fringe of her garment'. ከመ ናምልካ ኪያሃ: ናምልካ 'we may worship her' (ከመ + 1cp subjunctive of አምለከ 'worship' + -ኣ 'her', written -ካ), ኪያሃ 'her' the doubled independent object. ንሕነ 'we', ወእለ እምታሕቴነ 'and those under us', ወኵሉ መንግሥትነ 'and all our kingdom'. The quoted speech opens here and runs through the end of the part's message.

sentences.i: And now give it to him and say to him: Take this garment of Zion and worship it, for your mother sent for this reason; and you yourself said, Give us something to worship from the fringe (?) of her garment, so that we should not worship another, like the nations.'
sentences.n: ሀቦ 'give him' (imperative ሀብ + -ሁ 'him'); ወበሎ 'and say to him' (imperative በል + -ሎ). ንሥኣአ is printed with a doubled final አ (and below, ንሣእአ); read ንሣእ 'take' with -ኣ 'it' or a stray አ (?). አምልካ 'worship her/it' (imperative), the object doubled by ለዛቲ ልብሰ ጽዮን 'to this garment of Zion' (ለ- marks the object). Notice that the worship of the garment is the mother's own wish. ለአከት 'she sent' (ለአከ, 3fs); እምከ 'your mother' (እም + -ከ). በእንተዝ 'for this reason'. ወለሊከኒ 'and you yourself too' (ለሊከ 'yourself' + -ኒ). ዘናመልክ 'which we worship / may worship'. ከመ ኢናምልክ ባዕደ 'that we not worship another' (ከመ ኢ- with the subjunctive); ከመ አሕዛብ 'like the nations'. The speaker quoted to Menelik is Solomon's message, and the quotation marks open and close only by sense.

sentences.i: And Zion, the ark of the law of God, will be a guide to you wherever you are;
sentences.n: ጽዮንሂ: ጽዮን + ሂ (emphatic 'indeed, as for'). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'ark of his law, of God' in apposition to Zion: ሕጉ is ሕግ + -ሁ 'his law', then ለእግዚኣብሔር names the owner (a doubled possessive: 'his law, God's'). ታቦተ is the construct/accusative form of ታቦት 'ark'. This is the Zion = Ark theology of the book. ትኩንከ 'she will be to you' (ትኩን 3fs + -ከ), መርሐ 'a guide' (accusative, predicate); በኀበ ሀለውከ 'where you were/are' (ሀሎ 'to be' perfect, 2ms; the perfect here is a general present, 'wherever you are').

sentences.l: For said-to-him God to-Eli priest by-the-mouth-of Samuel prophet: I desired that you-abide, you and-house-of your-father, that you-burn-incense ark-of my-law and-you-abide before-me until for-ever; and-now-indeed I-repented, I-will-turn my-face from-you, for you-were-hardened-indeed (?), you-were-hardened (?), over my-sacrifice, and-you-loved your-sons more-than-me;
sentences.i: For God said to Eli the priest by the mouth of Samuel the prophet: 'I wished that you and your father's house should abide, and burn incense at the ark of my law, and abide before me for ever; but now I have repented. I will turn my face from you, for you have been stubborn (?) against my sacrifice, and you loved your sons more than me;
sentences.n: The allusion is 1 Samuel 2:27–30 (the word to Eli, there spoken by a 'man of God'; the book credits Samuel, cf. 1 Samuel 3:11–14); the book uses it as a warning: those who do not honour the Ark lose it. ይቤሎ 'he said to him' (ይቤ + -ሎ), ለኤሊ ካህን 'to Eli the priest'; በአፈ ሳሙኤል ነቢይ 'by the mouth of Samuel the prophet' (አፍ construct አፈ). ፈቀድኩ 'I wished' (1cs); ከመ ትንበሩ 'that you (pl.) dwell, remain'; ትዕጥኑ ታቦተ ሕግየ 'you burn incense (to/before) the ark of my law'; ትንበሩ ቅድሜየ 'you abide before me' (the same verb ነበረ as in ከመ ትንበሩ); እስከ ለዓለም 'for ever'. ወይእዜሰ 'and now indeed'. ተነሳሕኩ 'I have repented' (ተነሳሐ, 1cs); እመይጥ ገጽየ እምኔከ 'I will turn my face from you'. ተዐውሮ ተዐወርከ is an infinitive-plus-finite emphasis ('you were truly ...'); ተዐወረ is of uncertain root, perhaps from ዐወረ 'be blind' (so ch. 44 ተዐወሮ 'hardened against (?)' and ch. 46–48 ይትዔወራ), hence 'you have been stubborn (?) against my sacrifice'; the Greek of 1 Samuel 2:29 has 'a shameless eye' towards the sacrifice, which suits a sense of contempt. ላዕለ መሥዋዕትየ 'over my sacrifice'. ወአፍቀርከ ደቂቅከ እምኔየ 'and you loved your sons more than me' (አፍቀረ 'love', with እም- comparative).

I take the speaker to be Zadok answering Azarias, and 'he' the king; no main clause is recoverable and I offer no smooth reading (?).

sentences.l: Likewise they-run in-cart which-without before and-behind, without shaking, right or left. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: Likewise they ran along in the cart, without pitching forward or back (?), without jolting, to the right or to the left. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.n: ከማሁ 'likewise'. ዘአልቦ ቅድመ ወድኅረ 'which has no before or after' (hence 'no lurching forward or back'). ዘእንበለ ተሀውኮ 'without disturbance, shaking' (ተሀውኮ, a verbal noun of ተሀውከ). ይምነ ወፅግመ 'to the right and to the left'. The eight ፨ close the part; the journey goes on in the next part.

morph.gloss: likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu)
they run (3mp imperfect, r-w-ṣ)
in a cart (በ- + noun)
which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential)
before (preposition, construct) · adverbial 'forward' (ቅድመ ወድኅረ 'forward and back')
and behind, after (ወ- + preposition/adverb)

without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
shaking, jolting (verbal noun ተሀውኮ of ተሀውከ 'be shaken, disturbed', h-w-k)
right, right side (noun, here adverbial 'to the right'; spelled ይምነ)
and left side (ወ- + noun, adverbial accusative 'to the left')

glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ)

glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
glossary.እምኔከ: እም — from you (preposition እም with suffix -ኔከ '2ms')
glossary.እምኔየ: እም — than me (እም- + -ኔየ '1s me') · 'from me' (ትርሐቅ እምኔየ 'that you go far from me')
glossary.እምአብያጺሁ: አብያጽ — from its ... (እም- + noun + -ሁ '3ms its'; unknown word, perhaps its feeding-place) (?)
glossary.እምዘባናቲሆሙ: ዘባን — from their backs (እም- + plural ዘባናት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.እምዘፈረ: ዘፈር — from the edge, fringe of (እም- + noun, construct); sense guessed from context (?)
glossary.እምደረ: ደር — from the ... of (እም- + noun, construct; ደር a place-word, perhaps 'region'; meaning from context) (?)
glossary.እምድር: ምድር — from the earth (እም- + ምድር, the doubled ም written once; the Hebrew of 1 Samuel 2:8 has 'dust', this text does not)
glossary.እሞጻሃ: ሞጻ — of her fringe (እም- 'of, from' + ሞጻ + -ሃ '3fs her'; ሞጻ 'fringe' from context) (?)
glossary.እኁሁ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ከርሡለበሊዕ: ከርሥ — its belly for eating (ከርሥ + -ሁ, ለ- + በሊዕ 'eating', verbal noun of በልዐ; run together)
glossary.ኪያሃ: ኪያሃ — her (accusative independent pronoun, 3fs; object of ያኀድጉነ)
glossary.ኪዳነ: ኪዳን — covenant (noun, m.; construct 'covenant of') · accusative 'a covenant' as object (ሀበኒኬ ኪዳነ 'give me a covenant')
glossary.ካህነ: ካህን — priest (noun, accusative, predicate after ይኩንከ)
glossary.ኵሉንዋየ: ኵሉ — all goods of (ኵሉ + ንዋየ construct, written as one word)
glossary.ወሀገረ: ሀገር — and city of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወለሊከኒ: ለሊሁ — and you yourself, too (ወ- + ለሊከ 'you yourself', 2ms form of ለሊሁ, + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወለነሰ: ለ — and as for us (ወ- + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us' + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወለዐሥራተ: ዓሥራት — and for the tithes of (ወ- + ለ- + noun, accusative/construct)
glossary.ወለዘ: ዘ — and to that which (ወ- + ለ- + relative ዘ)
glossary.ወለዘርኡ: ዘርእ — and to his seed (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -ሁ 'his')
glossary.ወለዘርእከ: ዘርእ — and to your seed (ወ- + ለ- 'to' + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወለደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — and to the sons of (ወ- + ለ- + plural noun ደቂቅ, construct)
glossary.ወለጽዮን: ጽዮን — and to Zion (ወ- + ለ- + proper name)
glossary.ወልብሳ: ልብስ — and her garment (ወ- + noun + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወሖረ: ሖረ — and he went (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወመሃሬ: መሃሪ — and teacher (ወ- + participle of መሀረ 'teach', accusative predicate)
glossary.ወራእየ: ራእይ — and seer (ወ- + noun, accusative predicate; ራእይ is elsewhere 'vision', the sense 'seer' is from context) (?)
glossary.ወርቅ: ወርቅ — gold (noun; ንዋየ ወርቅ 'vessels of gold')
glossary.ወቀባኤ: ቀባኢ — and anointer (ወ- + participle of ቀብአ 'anoint', accusative predicate)
glossary.ወቃማ: ቃማ — unknown word (ወ- + noun), something of gold; meaning not established (?)
glossary.ወበሎ: ብህለ — and say to him! (ወ- + 2ms imperative በል, b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወበየብስኒ: የብስ — and on dry land too (ወ- + በ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወቤተ: ቤት — and the house of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወተሠርሐ: ተሠርሐ — and it was opened, made ready (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ሠርሐ 'open, prepare', ś-r-ḥ)
glossary.ወተካየዱ: ተካየደ — and they made a covenant (ወ- + 3mp perfect, reciprocal tä-stem, k-y-d; sense from context) (?)
glossary.ወተፈሥሐ: ተፈሥሐ — and he rejoiced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወታምሕል: አምሐለ — and you cause to swear (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, causative of መሐለ, ʾ-m-ḥ-l)
glossary.ወትረ: ወትር — always, continually (adverb, accusative; ወ- is part of the word)
glossary.ወትንበሩ: ነበረ — and that you abide, remain (ወ- + 2mp subjunctive, n-b-r)
glossary.ወነሥአ: ነሥአ — and he took (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወነቢየ: ነቢይ — and prophet (ወ- + noun, accusative predicate)
glossary.ወአልብሳ: አልበሰ — and clothe her! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative of ለበሰ 'wear', l-b-s, + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወአምሕል: አምሐለ — and make swear! (ወ- + 2ms imperative of the causative አምሐለ, ʾ-m-ḥ-l)
glossary.ወአምጽእ: አምጽአ — and bring! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative of መጽአ, ʾ-m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወአስተብፅዐ: አስተብፅዐ — and he praised, entreated (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative-reflexive of ብፅዐ; sense from context) (?)
glossary.ወአስተጋብኦን: አስተጋብአ — and gather them! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative of ተጋብአ 'assemble', g-b-ʾ, + -ኦን 'them', 3p)
glossary.ወአብቅልተ: በቅል — and mules (ወ- + plural አብቅልት, accusative)
glossary.ወአንብሮ: አንበረ — and set it! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative of ነበረ 'set, place', ʾ-n-b-r, + -ኦ 'it')
glossary.ወአንትሙሰ: አንትሙ — and you (pl.), for your part (ወ- + 2mp pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወአንከረ: አንከረ — and he marvelled (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ነከረ, ʾ-n-k-r)
glossary.ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.ወአዘዘ: አዘዘ — and he commanded (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወአፍራሰ: ፈረስ — and horses (ወ- + plural አፍራስ, accusative)
glossary.ወአፍቀርከ: አፍቀረ — and you loved (ወ- + 2ms perfect, ʾ-f-q-r)
glossary.ወኢናስተጠናቅቅ: አስተጠናቀቀ — and we do not take care (ወ- + ኢ- + 1cp imperfect; root ṭ-n-q-q, 'be careful, scrupulous'; lemma from the form) (?)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወእመሂ: እመ — and whether, or whether (ወ- 'and' + conjunction እመ + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወእምቀነየነ: ቀነየ — and than he subdued us (ወ- + እም- 'than' + 3ms perfect ቀነየ 'subdue', q-n-y, as ቀነዮሙ in ch. 25–26, + -ነ '1cp us') (?)
glossary.ወእምጸናጽል: ጸናጽል — and of the bells (ወ- + እም- 'of, from' + noun 'bells, sistra')
glossary.ወእስዕር: ሰዐረ — and I will root out (ወ- + 1cs imperfect/jussive, s-ʿ-r, 'uproot, abolish')
glossary.ወእኑም: እኑም — unknown word, perhaps a material or a process (ወ- + word); meaning from context (?)
glossary.ወእንስሳኒ: እንስሳ — and beasts too (ወ- + collective noun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this')
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and all of them, and all (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp')
glossary.ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዓሥራትኒ: ዓሥራት — and tithes too (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘንተኒ: ዝንቱ — and this also (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — and now, as for (ወ- 'and' + adverb 'now' + contrastive enclitic -ሰ 'as for, but')
glossary.ወጸዐኑ: ጸዐነ — and they loaded (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ṣ-ʿ-n)
glossary.ወጽዮንሂ: ጽዮን — and Zion, for her part (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወፅግመ: ፅግም — and left side (ወ- + noun, adverbial accusative 'to the left')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ዘላዕሌሃ: ላዕለ — which is upon her (ዘ- relative + ላዕሌ- 'upon' + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ዘሜላት: ሜላት — unknown word (ዘ- + noun), perhaps a material or craft term; meaning from context (?)
glossary.ዘተአዘዞ: ተአዘዘ — which was commanded him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of አዘዘ 'command', ʾ-z-z, + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ዘታሕቴሃ: ታሕተ — which is beneath her (ዘ- relative + ታሕቴ- 'beneath' + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ዘነገሮ: ነገረ — what he told him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, n-g-r, + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ዘናመልክ: አምለከ — what we worship (ዘ- relative + 1cp subjunctive, ʾ-m-l-k)
glossary.ዘአልቦ: አልቦ — which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential)
glossary.ዘአስተሐቀርዎ: አስተሐቀረ — who despised him (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, ḥ-q-r, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
glossary.ዘወፅአ: ወፅአ — that which went out (ዘ- 'which' + 3ms perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘዐሥቅ: ዐሠቀ — which is woven, worked (ዘ- relative + a form of ዐሠቀ 'weave'; lexical call from context) (?)
glossary.ዘይስሕቦ: ሰሐበ — who draws it (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, s-ḥ-b, + -ኦ '3ms it')
glossary.ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ዘይቤሎ: ብህለ — what he said to him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect ይቤ + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ዘገብሩ: ገብረ — which they made (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘፍትሎ: ፈትለ — of twisting (ዘ- 'of' + verbal noun of ፈትለ 'twist, spin', f-t-l; the final -ሎ unclear) (?)
glossary.ዝብጦ: ዝብጥ — unknown noun, perhaps a technique of weaving, + -ኦ '3ms its'; meaning from context (?)
glossary.የሀቦ: ወሀበ — that he give him (3ms jussive, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.የሐውር: ሖረ — he walks, goes (3ms imperfect, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ያሰርሖ: አሰርሐ — makes it hasten, drives it (3ms imperfect, causative, + -ኦ 'it'; root and sense from context) (?)
glossary.ያቀልልሥጋሁ: አቅለለ — he lightens his flesh (3ms imperfect, causative of ቀለለ 'be light', q-l-l, + ሥጋሁ 'his flesh' written as one word)
glossary.ያነውኃ: ነወኀ — makes it sail, drives it (3ms imperfect of the causative stem; lemma, root and sense from context) (?)
glossary.ይምነ: የማን — right, right side (noun, here adverbial 'to the right'; spelled ይምነ)
glossary.ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ይትሌዐሉ: ተለዐለ — they rise, are lifted (3mp imperfect, tä-stem, l-ʿ-l)
glossary.ይትሌዐል: ተለዐለ — he/it rises, is lifted (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, l-ʿ-l)
glossary.ይትመሐፀን: ተመሐፀነ — that he be protected, take refuge (3ms subjunctive, tä-stem of መሐፀነ, m-ḥ-ṣ-n) (?)
glossary.ይኩኖ: ኮነ — let it be to him (3ms jussive ይኩን + -ኖ '3ms to him')
glossary.ይጼዐኑ: ጸዐነ — they carry, which carry (3mp imperfect, G, 'carry, bear, load'; active, not passive)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ጽዑናን: ጽዑን — loaded, laden (passive participle of ጸዐነ, plural ጽዑናን)
glossary.ጽግነት: ጽግነት — unknown word, some flying creature; meaning from context (?)
glossary.ፈቀድኩ: ፈቀደ — I wished, desired (1cs perfect, G)
glossary.፪: ፪ — 2, spoken ክልኤቱ (kəlʾetu) 'two'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'two' (ዘእንበለ ፪ በትር 'except two rods')
glossary.፶፩: ፶፩ — 51, spoken ኀምሳ ወአሐዱ (ḫämsa wä-ʾaḥadu) 'fifty-one'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፶፪: ፶፪ — 52, spoken ኀምሳ ወክልኤቱ (ḫämsa wä-kəlʾetu) 'fifty-two'; chapter number (numeral)
